scope: Independent equation/evaluation probes and evidence audit for the 09.1 core-algorithm v1.1 draft. Synthetic tensors only; no corpus, checkpoint, query, holdout or sealed surface; no model training.

checks.name: state_box_preserved_all_tau_dt
checks.scope: Synthetic bounded initial state; does not prove attractors or semantics.

checks.name: tau_bounded_sigmoid_mapping
checks.scope: Logical microstep dt=1; the draft does not fix a mapping from microsteps to discount time units (§9.2).

checks.name: state_and_query_normalisers_jacobian
checks.scope: Fixed spectral-norm claim only; float32 tail behaviour is not the model's.

checks.name: proximal_erase_closed_form_and_bound
checks.scope: Per-step fixed-gate bound. The draft itself does not claim a whole-network contraction result.

value.scope_note: The normative bound depends on the B(x) map; an implementation that keeps an epsilon normaliser loses it.

checks.name: chi_couples_write_permission_and_decay
checks.limit: Not a mathematical failure: the draft says permission 0 skips the whole update. It is a semantic contract gap: forgetting is gated by the write-strength scalar, so memory does not decay while writes are suppressed unless a separate rule is declared.

checks.name: birth_neutrality_and_aggregate_credit
checks.limit: When requested units exceed rank(C_i), the surplus units get exactly zero startup gradient (see per_unit_startup_gradient_norms). The draft states the non-zero-singular-value condition but fixes no rank-aware rule for r.

checks.name: conditional_birth_four_point_witness

random_content_blind_gate.note: The expectation over content-blind gates is zero, but a single four-point draw has large variance; a random gate can produce a large but directionally meaningless startup gradient.

checks.limit: The witness uses a hand-chosen gate aligned with x1. Content-blind gates cancel in expectation; the draft's 'unsupervised content cluster' route for gates is an assumption, not a guarantee.

checks.name: conditional_birth_learnability_smoke
checks.limit: Toy four-point optimisation only; not evidence of model-level learning, generalisation or growth benefit.

value.note: The archived check compares the same hand-written expression through numpy.power; this probe builds a per-event reference instead.

value.interpretation: An absolute criterion larger than the signal admits relative errors above 100%; consistency checks of autograd vs finite differences also validate the implementation, not the equation.

value.note: Local derivative only: E1 states it holds with F_t and F_tilde fixed and away from the projection boundary; the full graph also contains gate/state dependencies.

checks.name: archived_reports_reproduce_and_hashes_match
checks.scope: Reproduction and integrity only; it does not upgrade the strength of individual checks.

coverage_notes: The 2026-10-31 E1 erratum (§21 gap table) now says the committed 22 checks are a synthetic coupled *proxy* and lists five missing rows (continuous chi, formal fast read, formal inter-group Q/K/V, query-conditioned common read/expression, float32 effective updates/meta-learning). This evaluation confirms that list and adds three residual points E1 does not state: (a) the three semi-Markov checks are arithmetic identities, not implementations; (b) the finite-difference checks cover only the first coordinate of each parameter; (c) several pass conditions are weak/non-discriminating (finite-only, nonzero-gradient-only, ordering-only).

The committed coupled reference is a reduced analogue, not a full instance of §4-§13: it uses fixed sigmoid gates instead of state/error-conditioned gate MLPs, a single fast head with k=v=3, no chi interpolation (hard on/off only), no copy/pointer head, no low-rank U/V adaptation inside the coupled checks, no policy/actor-critic implementation, and no consolidation projection (except one synthetic anchor in the v1 suite).

§7.2 expression (copy/pointer mixture), §8 world-prediction heads, §10.2 consolidation, §11.3 group/memory growth, §12 mode policy and §13 transaction recovery have no computed check in either archived suite.
The three semi-Markov checks are arithmetic identities over hand-written expressions; there is no TD or eligibility-trace implementation in the repository yet, so they cannot validate one.
The birth-credit checks validate the aggregate-loss convention and neutrality, not that a newborn unit receives useful credit in a real forward pass (draft §21 says this explicitly).

assumptions.note: Rank, head merge, patch-to-event projection and g/D_nu interfaces are not fixed by the draft; counts are an order-of-magnitude audit.

bptt_window.note: Graph memory for create_graph/meta steps is excluded and must be measured by 09.2.

limits: Local algebraic/optimisation/smoke evidence only. No claim of model capability, lifetime continuity, language ability, growth benefit, retention or recovery follows from this report. Sign conventions, thresholds and coverage are stated per check; smoke checks are labelled.
